scenes.title: DEFECTION & THE FLEET
scenes.slug: INT. OSE'S OFFICE / EXT. THE LONG WALK
scenes.objective: Riya wants six skiffs; Ose wants the Authority to survive.

shots.action: Ose's ivory office, Level 30. One enormous rain-lashed window. The scale model of the Tidewall between them like a chessboard
shots.light: warm ivory practicals; storm-blue from the window; the two temperatures never mix
shots.vfx: CG storm city beyond the glass
shots.sound: the storm is silent through the glass — a pressure, not a noise

shots.action: 'Then in an hour nobody will remember that I didn't. That's the first argument for his plan I've found genuinely persuasive.'
shots.light: ivory key, storm-blue rim
shots.sound: no score

shots.action: Riya's rank bars set on the ivory desk. Then her hands TEAR the insignia off her shoulder, leaving a darker unfaded patch
shots.light: ivory
shots.vfx: none — practical costume action, CONTINUITY CRITICAL from here on
shots.sound: thread tearing; the bars on wood

shots.angle: eye, over Ose's shoulder at the window
shots.action: Facing away, dismissing her: 'Skiff Six is scheduled for maintenance. It won't be logged as missing until oh-nine-hundred. Neither will the five parked next to it.'
shots.light: backlit, in silhouette against storm
shots.sound: rain hitting glass hard once, like punctuation

shots.angle: low, from the water, looking up at the Long Walk
shots.action: STORM NIGHT on the Stiltway. The temporary rope bridge over the gap Arjun made in Sc.6. Wind tearing at tarpaulins
shots.light: lightning, sodium floods, LED strings whipping and shorting
shots.vfx: storm sim; the Sc.6 gap and its rope bridge — CONTINUITY CRITICAL
shots.sound: storm; rope under load; steel banging

shots.action: Arjun and Meera cross the rope bridge in the storm and come up onto the walkway — and STOP
shots.light: lightning; lamps ahead
shots.sound: their breathing; then a rising human sound

shots.action: THE ENTIRE STILTWAY IS WAITING: Bhaskar, boat crews, kite kids, the noodle-stall woman, four hundred people with lamps in the rain
shots.light: four hundred handheld lamps and torches — the warmest wide shot in the film
shots.sound: rain on four hundred plastic capes; nobody speaking

shots.action: 'I broke this walkway.' / 'You held it up, you idiot.' Bhaskar thumbs at ninety boats below
shots.light: lamp key, gold tooth catching
shots.sound: shouting over the storm

shots.angle: high, looking down at the water
shots.action: NINETY BOATS below the Stiltway, lamps lit, engines turning over in a category-five storm
shots.light: ninety lamps on black water
shots.vfx: CG boat fleet extension; ocean sim
shots.sound: ninety two-stroke engines; the score's first statement of the Fleet theme

scenes.title: THE ARK / THE OFFER
scenes.slug: INT. THE ARK — ASSEMBLY HALL & MOON POOL
scenes.objective: Dev wants his daughter to say yes.

shots.action: The Assembly Hall: bone-white, 30m ceilings, absolutely nothing on any wall, two hundred Hollow standing motionless at the edges, a 40m circular Moon Pool of black water at the centre
shots.light: even, sourceless, shadowless white — no visible fixtures anywhere
shots.vfx: CG hall extension; the moon pool water; 200 crowd
shots.sound: NO ROOM TONE AT ALL. No hum, no air handling, nothing. Acoustically dead

shots.action: Kira barefoot in a bone-white shift, six braids loose, palms bandaged — and Arjun's brass regulator still clipped at her waist, the one dirty object in the frame
shots.light: shadowless white; her skin is the only warm value in shot
shots.sound: her bare feet on lacquer — the only sound

shots.action: A small white dish holding three copper clips and one brass earring. Removed. Waiting
shots.light: shadowless white
shots.sound: silence

shots.action: Dev walks to her barefoot and stops at a respectful distance — and does not try to touch her. CRYSTALLISATION STAGE 3: left jaw, neck, shoulder and chest
shots.light: shadowless white; the crystal is the only thing in frame that refracts
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Stage 3 crystallisation with internal light drift
shots.sound: his bare feet; his breathing has a faint crystalline resonance now

shots.action: 'You've got her hands. She had these terrible strong hands, and she'd—' He stops, frustrated with himself. 'I've got the sentence. I don't have the picture.'
shots.light: shadowless white
shots.sound: nothing

shots.angle: high, looking down at the Moon Pool
shots.move: slow crane down toward the water
shots.action: He raises a hand. The black water goes STILL AS GLASS. The Concord blooms on it
shots.light: the projection becomes the only light source; two figures lit from below by a memory
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — the Concord projection: not a hologram; a warm, grain-true, sunlit image lying ON black water like a reflection of a day that isn't there
shots.sound: a market, distant, from underwater

shots.action: AMARA OKONKWO on the black water — tall, close-cropped hair, medic's kit, RED THREAD on her wrist — laughing at something off-frame, a five-year-old on her hip
shots.light: warm real 2059 sunlight inside the projection; ice-white room around it
shots.vfx: period plate composited onto water surface with true water displacement
shots.sound: her laugh, filtered, ninety seconds long, looping

shots.action: Kira makes a sound that is not a word. Warm light from below on her face for the first time since the kite-field
shots.light: warm underlight from the water
shots.sound: her breath breaking

shots.angle: eye, both facing the water, not each other
shots.action: 'In a shared field, a recording isn't a recording. It's a place. You could go and stand in it.' / 'And the price.' / 'You lose the ache.'
shots.light: warm from below, cold from everywhere
shots.sound: the looping laugh under the dialogue

shots.action: THE GENTLEST LINE IN THE FILM: 'I'm not asking you to forget your mother. I'm asking you to stop being punished for having had one.' Beat. 'You're allowed to want it.'
shots.light: warm under, white over
shots.sound: nothing under it

shots.action: 'I want it.' / 'I know.' Her bandaged hand rises toward the image and gold light stirs at her fingertips, UNBIDDEN — she is already weaving
shots.light: warm under; gold from her own fingers entering frame
shots.sound: the tether tone, out of tune, quiet

scenes.title: SUIT-UP / THE LAST PAGE
scenes.slug: INT. DROWNED CATHEDRAL / EXT. BHASKAR'S YARD
scenes.objective: Recover three Corps mantles; Arjun writes his last page.

shots.action: The Drowned Cathedral again — identical to Sc.2, plus a fresh silt cloud. Arjun cuts the chain on a rusted rack of Corps mantles
shots.light: the same single green god-ray; his amber lamp
shots.vfx: CG environment (must match Sc.2 exactly); silt; bolt cutter
shots.sound: underwater; chain parting

shots.action: Three mantles come free in a slow cloud of silt and hang in the water like drowned men: a Bastion cuirass, a Tether harness, and a third, smaller, that they take and never use
shots.light: god-ray behind, amber lamp front
shots.vfx: cloth sim underwater; the third mantle is planted for a payoff that never comes — deliberately
shots.sound: a long low chord

shots.action: BHASKAR'S YARD, pre-dawn: sparks. Bhaskar fits the salt-pitted cuirass and replaces three rivets with MISMATCHED STEEL ONES
shots.light: welding arc as a hard blue strobe key; oil-drum fire warm fill; blue pre-dawn ambient
shots.sound: grinder, hammer, rain on steel

shots.action: Meera's ONE HAND re-channelling the forearm bracers so the conduit lines align exactly with Arjun's actual Threadwork scars
shots.light: work-lamp, brass specular
shots.vfx: the alignment of suit channel and skin scar — the film's best costume idea, shot as evidence
shots.sound: small tools; her prosthetic servo

shots.action: NINETY SECONDS WITH NO DIALOGUE: Riya loading Nullpins she may not be able to use on anything; boats being fuelled; the storm coming in from the north; a kid taping a saffron kite to a mast for luck
shots.light: blue pre-dawn, orange fire, white welding arc
shots.vfx: storm approach in the background of every shot
shots.sound: work sounds; the score carries the whole montage

shots.action: Arjun sits apart on an upturned crate and opens the notebook for the last time
shots.light: one bulb on a wire, rain-light
shots.sound: the montage score drops out abruptly

shots.angle: DIRECTLY OVERHEAD, LOCKED — the film's signature insert
shots.action: THE LAST PAGE, written in real time: 'Read this first. You won't know me... You did a good thing. You won't remember it. That's allowed.'
shots.light: one warm bulb, rain spotting the paper as he writes
shots.vfx: none — real handwriting, real rain on real paper
shots.sound: pencil; rain; nothing else

shots.action: He tears the page out — as always — and then, for the first time in the film, PUTS IT BACK IN. Ties the red boot-lace
shots.light: bulb
shots.sound: paper; lace

shots.action: 'Don't give it to me until it's over.' / 'And if it isn't over?' / 'Then read it to yourself and skip the last line.'
shots.light: bulb, blue dawn behind them
shots.sound: the fleet's engines starting, distant

shots.angle: low hero angle — the film's ONLY conventional hero shot
shots.action: Arjun stands in the finished Bastion mantle: charcoal weave, salt-pitted brass cuirass, single left pauldron, teal cloak, open-channel bracers, no helmet. Rain. Ninety boats behind him
shots.light: blue pre-dawn key, orange fire rim, one lamp flare
shots.sound: the Guardian theme, full orchestra, first and only unironic statement

scenes.title: THE CROSSING
scenes.objective: Get ninety boats forty kilometres across open water.

shots.action: Eight-metre swell. Ninety fishing boats, drum-floats, a dredger, six grey Kestrels running low with fans howling. Riya's #6 with the cracked cowling out front
shots.light: storm-dark dawn; every boat lamp a smear; lightning every 9 seconds
shots.vfx: full CG ocean sim; fleet; storm; rain
shots.sound: the sea; ninety engines; wind at 130km/h

shots.action: Arjun in the bow of Bhaskar's boat, teal cloak snapping, one hand flat on the gunwale — ANCHORING the hull every time it should have gone over; cyan pulses along the waterline with each wave
shots.light: cyan pulse as the only steady light; lightning; lamp
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — anchoring: cyan hexagon lattice flashing along the hull's waterline on each impact, water deforming around a hull that refuses to roll
shots.sound: the chime, once per wave, becoming a rhythm

shots.action: Ninety boats in a following line, each one steering by the cyan light ahead of them like a lamp
shots.light: cyan point source in a black storm
shots.sound: the Fleet theme rising under the storm

shots.action: Riya in skiff #6, orange flotation vest, braid plastered, water pouring off her, flying by hand in a category five
shots.light: instrument glow, lightning
shots.sound: fan scream; her breathing steady

shots.angle: low, from the water, looking up
shots.action: THE ARK REVEALED: 240 metres of bone-white on four legs, 80m above the sea, immaculate in a black storm, 144 white transmission spines lit along the upper deck
shots.light: the Ark is self-lit and perfectly even — a clean white object in an filthy black sky
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — full CG rig, absolutely spotless, no rust, no rain streaking (the rain does not appear to stick to it)
shots.sound: a rising sub-bass tone from the rig that the storm cannot cover

shots.action: 'Look at that thing. It's so clean.' / Meera on the radio: 'That's how you know.'
shots.light: the Ark's white bounce now keying their faces from ahead
shots.sound: radio distortion; the storm

scenes.title: THE STAIRCASE OF LIGHT
scenes.slug: EXT. THE ARK — LOWER DECK & LEG THREE
scenes.objective: Get four hundred people onto a rig eighty metres above the sea.

shots.action: Grapples fired; cargo nets; the dredger's crane arm bent screaming against Leg Three
shots.light: storm dark, boat lamps, white Ark bounce from above
shots.sound: steel failing; shouting in three languages

shots.action: Arjun anchors on a swinging cargo net and builds STAIRS out of hardlight up the leg — hexagon by hexagon, each one visibly costing him
shots.light: cyan from each new stair lighting the rain around it
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — sequential hexagonal stair construction, 1 step per 0.4s, each with a chime
shots.sound: a chime per step, ascending in pitch — the film's most musical VFX

shots.angle: extreme wide, low, from the water
shots.action: THE FILM'S BIGGEST IMAGE: four hundred ordinary boat people climbing a staircase of cyan light up the leg of a bone-white rig in a category-five storm
shots.light: the staircase is the only light in a black frame; four hundred silhouettes on it
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — crowd sim on hardlight geometry with correct translucency and shadow-casting
shots.sound: the Fleet theme and the Guardian theme played together for the first time

shots.action: Hollow at the rail above, calm, dropping resonance charges without hurry
shots.light: Ark white from behind them; they are silhouettes with white edges
shots.sound: no shouting from them at all

shots.action: A charge takes out a section of stair; nine people fall; Arjun rebuilds it MID-FALL and catches them — and loses one
shots.light: detonation white, then cyan re-forming
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — stair destruction and reconstruction in the same 2 seconds
shots.sound: the chime rebuilding out of the explosion

shots.action: Bhaskar sees his nineteen-year-old nephew go into the black water. THE FILM DOES NOT CUT AWAY FROM HIS FACE. He keeps climbing
shots.light: cyan from the stair below, storm above
shots.sound: everything drops except rain for 4 seconds

shots.action: Riya, braid soaked, orange vest, running the flank with a bullhorn and no rank: 'Nobody climbs alone, everybody climbs roped!'
shots.light: lamp, cyan spill
shots.sound: bullhorn distortion

shots.action: On the upper deck: Kira in the white shift at the rail — FREE, unguarded, choosing to be there — watching the staircase come up the leg. Her father beside her
shots.light: Ark white; storm behind
shots.sound: the storm, suddenly audible again

shots.action: Genuinely moved: 'That's the most Guardian thing I have ever seen.' Then, to a Hollow: 'Don't fire on the civilians. Not one.'
shots.light: Ark white key
shots.sound: his voice level

scenes.title: MIRRORS
scenes.objective: Sera holds the hall six minutes; Arjun needs four.

shots.action: A white cathedral of nothing. Two figures a hundred metres apart. Sera walks out to the middle and draws the resonance blade
shots.light: shadowless white; both figures cast NO shadow, which is the location's horror
shots.sound: the room has no reverb; footsteps land dead

shots.action: 'You've done this twice. It went badly twice. Badly twice.'
shots.light: white
shots.sound: the echo

shots.action: BEAT ONE: he throws a bastion; reflected; he goes thirty metres down the hall. He gets up
shots.light: cyan flash, silver inversion
shots.sound: chime; reversed chime; a body on lacquer

shots.action: BEAT TWO: same again. Blood in his teeth. Sera has not hurried once
shots.light: white
shots.sound: the same two sounds, which is the point

shots.action: Three copy-steps from three angles; three cuts land: forearm, thigh, and a resonance-blade slash across the cuirass that opens a conduit channel — his LEFT ARM GOES DEAD
shots.light: white; the wounded conduit channel sparks cyan then goes grey
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — copy-step afterimages; conduit channel failure with light draining out of it like blood
shots.sound: the 4kHz blade whine stopping dead three times

shots.action: He crawls. She follows at a walk, narrating kindly: 'You keep trying to put a wall between yourself and a mirror. Between yourself and a mirror.'
shots.light: white; his blood is the only colour on the floor
shots.sound: her voice; his dragging

shots.action: Face down on white lacquer, one arm dead — he LAUGHS. Once. Painfully. 'Third law. Never shield what you can move.'
shots.light: white
shots.sound: the laugh; then silence

shots.action: His good palm goes flat — NOT in front of her. ON THE FLOOR
shots.light: white; cyan beginning under his fingers
shots.sound: a single deep chime, different in pitch from all previous

shots.action: THE REVERSAL: the hardlight crystallises BENEATH the deck plate and prises it up; ten square metres of floor flips; Sera drops through her own floor — a fall she cannot reflect
shots.light: cyan from below through the tearing seam
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — deck plate inversion and structural failure driven by hardlight from underneath
shots.sound: steel shearing; a long fall

shots.angle: extreme high, looking down through the hole
shots.action: Sera wedged in the dark ballast void below, alive, chest plate cracked, staring up
shots.light: one shaft of white from the hole; everything else black — the only chiaroscuro on the entire Ark
shots.sound: water sloshing below her

shots.action: In the cracked mirror of her own gauntlet, six inches from her face, is HER OWN REFLECTION, and she cannot look away
shots.light: the single white shaft
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — her face in her own broken plate, fragmented into nine pieces
shots.sound: her breathing changing for the first time in the film

shots.action: 'Get me out — I can see her — who is that.' / 'That's you.' He leaves the rope. He doesn't wait to see if she takes it
shots.light: white above, black below
shots.sound: the rope hitting the void floor

scenes.title: THE REFUSAL
scenes.objective: Dev needs Kira to weave; Kira needs to decide who she is.

shots.action: Kira at the eight primary tether-lines above the black water, gold already running up her forearms; Dev behind her, not touching, hands at his sides
shots.light: warm projection from below, white from everywhere
shots.vfx: eight standing crystal tether-lines; her forearm ignition
shots.sound: the eight lines each holding a different pitch

shots.action: She raises her hands. Six tethers. Then — for the first time — a SEVENTH. The room brightens
shots.light: her gold now overpowering the white
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — the seventh tether: brighter, unstable, wrong
shots.sound: seven tones, the seventh dissonant

shots.action: A small brass object skids across white lacquer: THE ANCHOR-STONE, thrown from the hall doorway by a bleeding man in a torn mantle
shots.light: white floor, amber pulse
shots.sound: brass on lacquer — small, tinny, and completely out of place

shots.action: The stone opens: a volumetric of Arjun recorded that morning at Bhaskar's yard, rain on his shoulders, reading awkwardly from a notebook
shots.light: the volumetric is warm, grainy and low-res against the perfect white room
shots.vfx: volumetric projection with grain and edge dissolve
shots.sound: his recorded voice carries YARD ROOM TONE — rain, a grinder — into a silent white room

shots.action: 'Three: Kira Okonkwo is seventeen years old. She robbed me in the rain, and she was right about the rig, and she flies kites like it's an argument she's winning.' Beat. 'It hurts, and I would not trade one line of it.'
shots.light: self-lit volumetric
shots.sound: his voice; nothing else

shots.action: Seven tethers hang in the air, UNWOVEN. She lowers her hands
shots.light: gold dying back to white
shots.sound: seven tones sagging out of tune

shots.action: One at a time: copper clip into a braid. Copper clip. Copper clip. Brass earring. Then her fist closing around Arjun's regulator
shots.light: white
shots.sound: four small metallic sounds, spaced

shots.action: 'I was five. I remember two things. Her collar, and no sound. Everyone in that market got a whole life and I got a collar and a silence, and it is MINE, and you don't get it.'
shots.light: white
shots.sound: her voice steady for the first time in the film

shots.action: 'You said you'd give me a place to stand in with her. You can't even remember her face.' Off Dev: something goes very, very quiet. '...No. I can't.'
shots.light: white; the crystalline half of his face refracting the projection below
shots.sound: the projection loop is suddenly very loud

shots.action: He puts his crystalline hand on the Concord spindle: 'I'm going to do it without you. It will be cruder. Some of them won't survive the pass. I don't know how to be a person who stops.'
shots.light: the spindle begins to light from within — the first non-even light on the Ark
shots.sound: a tone climbing out of the sub-bass

shots.action: The Ark's 144 spines light one after another across 240 metres, and a white ring expands outward over the storm at the speed of weather
shots.light: the Ark becomes, for four seconds, the brightest object in the film so far
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — the Concord launch: a soft white expanding annulus, no shockwave, no fire, gentle and enormous
shots.sound: the tone reaching a pitch that hurts, then going inaudible

shots.action: FORTY KILOMETRES AWAY, THE STILTWAY: a mother stops mid-sentence; a boy's hands go slack on a kite line; four hundred faces on the Long Walk go smooth and calm at the same instant, and STOP
shots.light: grey morning storm-light, unchanged, which makes it unbearable
shots.vfx: crowd performance — no VFX at all on the people. The absence of any effect is the effect
shots.sound: the city's sound dies in a two-second fade, leaving only rain

scenes.title: THE LOOM (CLIMAX A)
scenes.objective: Arjun must stop a man who is stronger, unkillable, and not wrong.

shots.action: A 200-metre geode: standing crystal filament floor to ceiling like the strings of a stadium-sized harp; a brass ring platform at the centre; a single catwalk in
shots.light: fully emissive walls — white-blue, rising; there are no lamps anywhere in this location
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — the Loom: full CG cavity, 40,000 crystal strings with individual light propagation
shots.sound: 38Hz in every frame; the strings ringing faintly when the air moves

shots.action: Dev at the spindle, weaving eight million people BY HAND, crudely — and it is killing him. CRYSTALLISATION STAGE 4: left hand entirely crystal and CRACKING
shots.light: the spindle white-blue from below
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Stage 4 with fracture propagation across the crystal in real time
shots.sound: crystal cracking, small and constant, under everything

shots.action: Arjun walks the catwalk: torn mantle, dead left arm, blood, one working hand
shots.light: emissive walls rimming him on both sides, no key at all on his face
shots.sound: his boots on brass; the hum

shots.action: BEAT ONE: Arjun builds a bastion. Dev makes a ROOM out of light around it and the bastion shatters like a teacup. 'I taught you that.'
shots.light: cyan, then engulfed in white-blue architecture
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Dev's Loom-class construction appears FULLY FORMED in one frame (he never builds), enclosing and crushing Arjun's cyan geometry
shots.sound: chime; then a cathedral-sized chord; then breaking glass

shots.action: BEAT TWO: Arjun drives a bastion up through the platform; Dev unmakes it with a gesture. 'And that.'
shots.light: cyan, unmade
shots.sound: the chime played backwards, cleanly

shots.action: Arjun STOPS. He walks the last twenty metres with his hands open
shots.light: emissive white-blue
shots.sound: the fighting sounds stop; only the hum

shots.action: 'You're right. I've had twelve years of your cure by accident. It's the worst thing that has ever happened to anyone, and I'm the only man alive who can tell you that from the inside, and you never once asked me.'
shots.light: white-blue, no fill
shots.sound: no score

shots.action: Hands still on the spindle: 'Because the alternative is the shaft. The alternative is a boy who loved me pulling a ring.'
shots.light: white-blue, crystal refracting
shots.sound: crystal cracking

shots.action: The anchor-stone held open on Arjun's palm — offered the way you'd offer food. Not a weapon
shots.light: white-blue with the stone's amber
shots.sound: the 1Hz bell against the 38Hz hum

shots.action: 'Amara was a carrier, Dev. She's in here. All of her. I'm giving it back so you know what you're selling.' / 'Arjun. Don't.'
shots.light: white-blue
shots.sound: Dev afraid for the first time

shots.action: The stone pressed against the crystalline plate of Dev's chest. IT OPENS
shots.light: amber flooding into white-blue
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — the stone's light entering crystal tissue and propagating through it like ink in water
shots.sound: everything stops

shots.move: loose handheld — the only warm handheld in Act III
shots.action: THE FILM GOES SILENT AND WARM: Anjari market 14:11, real, unedited, from Amara's own trace. Her hands. The red thread. A five-year-old on her hip complaining about mangoes. 'Dev, she's heavy, she's your daughter, come and take her—' She turns, laughing, toward camera. Then, from inside her own last ninety seconds: the white light
shots.light: real hot afternoon sun; full saturation; the warmest images in the entire film
shots.vfx: period environment; the bloom's arrival at the end
shots.sound: a real market, at full volume, then absolute silence

shots.action: Dev Aranya gets it back. All of it. At once. He makes a sound no human being should make and falls to his knees on the brass ring, both hands over his face — one flesh, one crystal
shots.light: white-blue, and amber leaking out between his fingers
shots.vfx: crystallisation; light through the crystal hand
shots.sound: the sound; then the 38Hz hum, alone

shots.action: 'Oh. Oh, there you are.' Above him, eight million minds hang half-woven
shots.light: white-blue from above through the half-woven field
shots.vfx: the half-woven Concord as a vast, slow, unstable lattice overhead
shots.sound: eight million faint tones, none of them resolving

scenes.title: THE GROUND (CLIMAX B)
scenes.slug: INT. THE LOOM → EXT. THE ARK
scenes.objective: Ground eight million people's worth of resonance.

shots.action: The Loom climbing to white. Arjun tears the mantle open and puts the copper disc against his sternum. Reverses it
shots.light: white-blue rising to painful
shots.vfx: stabiliser reversal — a small, unglamorous mechanical action
shots.sound: Meera on the radio, distorted: 'GROUND IT.'

shots.action: Kira comes down the catwalk at a dead run: 'NO—'
shots.light: white-blue
shots.sound: her boots; her voice

shots.action: THE SHOT THAT ENDS PEOPLE: he turns, completely calm, and SMILES at her. 'Kira Okonkwo. Seventeen. Kites.' Beat. 'See? I still had it.'
shots.light: white-blue key, warm amber fill from the stone at his feet
shots.sound: the score's Memory theme, solo piano, first time unaccompanied

shots.action: Dev, on his knees, looks up and does the last free thing he has: 'Not him.' Both hands on the spindle. He REVERSES THE LOOM HIMSELF, taking the first third of the load through his own crystal body
shots.light: white flooding up through him
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — light entering a crystalline body and fracturing outward
shots.sound: the hum inverting into a descending tone

shots.action: Dev burns from the inside out — white light through crystal, fractures racing across chest and face — and in the last two seconds it is unmistakably HIS OWN FACE, human, wrecked, awake
shots.light: he is his own light source
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — crystal-to-ash transition that must resolve to a HUMAN face in the final 48 frames
shots.sound: cracking; and under it, one clean human breath

shots.action: He finds Kira in the light: 'Kira.' And he gets it right. 'Your mother's laugh. It came out of you.' Then ash and white light
shots.light: blinding
shots.sound: silence on the cut

shots.action: THE REST OF THE LOAD COMES DOWN. Arjun anchors, both palms on bare crystal, and GROUNDS IT. Every filament in his body lights at once; the conduit channels blow out; cyan goes to white and past white
shots.light: he becomes the brightest object ever seen in the film; the camera exposure visibly cannot hold it
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — full-body Threadwork white-out with conduit rupture; practical exposure clipping preserved, not smoothed
shots.sound: a roar with no low end — all treble, like a held breath

shots.action: From orbit: a column of light forty kilometres wide standing on the delta for two seconds, then gone
shots.light: the light is the subject
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — orbital plate; cloud displacement; the column has no smoke and no debris
shots.sound: nothing. Space

shots.action: THE STILTWAY: four hundred faces on the Long Walk come back on ALL AT ONCE, mid-sentence. A mother finishes her sentence. A boy's hands close on a kite line
shots.light: grey morning
shots.sound: the city's sound rushing back in like water

shots.action: SIX SECONDS INSIDE ARJUN: notebook pages / Ila's badly-drawn fish / Riya in the rain / the noodle stall / Meera's brass hand / Bhaskar's gold tooth / a saffron kite — each arriving and then simply GOING OUT, like windows in a tower at the end of a night. The last to go is Kira on the salt flats, laughing, mid-swing on a gold line
shots.light: pure white ground, each memory a warm island in it
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — memories extinguishing, not shattering. No glass, no shards, no fire. They just stop being lit
shots.sound: each memory carries two seconds of its own scene's audio, then silence

shots.action: EXT. THE ARK, SUNRISE: the 144 spines go dark one by one. The Loom's hum STOPS — and its absence is the loudest thing in the film
shots.light: the Ark's self-light dying; real dawn arriving to replace it
shots.sound: THE 38Hz DROPS OUT after 129 minutes of film. The silence is physical

shots.action: Kira drags Arjun out onto the upper deck. He is breathing. His Threadwork is DEAD PEWTER. His eyes are open and pleasant and empty
shots.light: first real sunlight of the film on white lacquer
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Threadwork rendered permanently dead: matte grey, no emission, ever again
shots.sound: wind; boats; people

shots.angle: low, from the deck, looking up
shots.action: AND THE STORM BREAKS. Not dramatically — it thins, and tears, and there is a seam of gold, and then, for the first time in two hours and five minutes: SKY
shots.light: clean blue with gold at the seam; the first unfiltered sunlight since Sc.1
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — cloud dissolution; this is the single most important lighting event in the film
shots.sound: wind dropping; and the score, finally, in a major key, full

shots.action: Four hundred soaked boat people on the deck of a bone-white rig, looking up at blue
shots.light: blue sky bounce on four hundred wet faces
shots.sound: nobody cheers. They just look

shots.action: Riya takes his face in both hands: 'Do you know me?' / 'No. Should I be worried? You look like it's bad news.' / She laughs and it comes out as a sob. Forehead to forehead
shots.light: golden sunrise key
shots.sound: her laugh-sob; wind

shots.action: Kira apart at the rail, watching the sun come up over ninety fishing boats, palms open, gold light still running quietly in her hands
shots.light: sunrise backlight; gold on gold
shots.sound: the sea; the score resolving

scenes.title: FOUR MONTHS LATER
scenes.slug: EXT. THE STILTWAY & TOWER SIX ROOF
scenes.objective: Hand the film to its new owner.

shots.angle: drone, slow descent through the towers
shots.move: aerial descent — the mirror of shot 3A
shots.action: The Stiltway in CLEAN MORNING LIGHT: loud, wet, alive, rebuilding. The Long Walk's mid-span is NEW UNTREATED BAMBOO, pale and bright against everything rusted
shots.light: clear morning sun, hard and warm — the first clean sky in the film
shots.vfx: CG city; the rebuilt span — CONTINUITY CRITICAL
shots.sound: hammering, radios, kids, gulls, engines. The city at full volume

shots.move: slow tilt up — mirror of shot 3C
shots.action: Hundreds of memorial kites along the ropes — AND THIS TIME THEY ARE COLOURED. Saffron, teal, oxblood, magenta
shots.light: backlit by clear sun; the colour is the point
shots.sound: paper and wind; and this time it sounds like celebration

shots.action: KIRA OKONKWO in a fitted Corps Tether mantle, full saffron cloak, six braids, three copper clips, brass regulator on her belt — six gold tethers out, hauling a four-tonne girder into place while twenty workers guide it and a dozen kids run underneath screaming
shots.light: clear sun; the gold tethers barely visible against a bright sky, which is right — she doesn't need the dark to be seen
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — six load-bearing tethers with a real girder; the gold now reads as work light, not weapon light
shots.sound: steel, shouting, laughter; the Guardian theme in a new, lighter orchestration

shots.action: 'LEFT! LEFT, GIRL—' / 'IT IS LEFT!' Bhaskar has a new apprentice's cap on the crate beside him and does not explain it
shots.light: clear sun
shots.sound: the yard

shots.action: A jetty. Arjun in a plain cotton shirt, sleeves rolled, barefoot, hands on his knees, watching the water with the perfect calm of a man with nothing behind him. His Threadwork is dull pewter
shots.light: clear morning, water bounce
shots.sound: water on wood

shots.action: Riya sits down with two glasses of chai. 'Chai.' / He sips, makes a face: 'It's very sweet.' / 'Yes. It is.' They sit
shots.light: clear morning
shots.sound: the city behind them

shots.angle: DIRECTLY OVERHEAD, LOCKED — the signature insert, final use
shots.action: THE NOTEBOOK placed in his hands: waterlogged, swollen, red boot-lace. Opened. The last page. We hear it in his own four-month-old voice
shots.light: clear sun on wet-warped paper
shots.sound: his V.O.; the city faded back

shots.action: He reads it twice. His face doesn't change much — there's no memory to attach it to. But his thumb goes over the last line, once
shots.light: clear sun
shots.sound: paper; water

shots.action: 'Was I? Better or worse than this?' / Riya, watching Kira haul four tonnes of steel on threads of gold light: 'Oh, you were nowhere near.'
shots.light: clear sun
shots.sound: the yard; her small laugh

shots.action: Kira drops onto the jetty, lands light, out of breath, grinning, and puts out her hand: 'Morning. I'm Kira.' / 'Arjun. Apparently.' / 'Yeah. Apparently.'
shots.light: clear sun
shots.sound: her landing; the handshake

shots.action: 'Come up on the roof. There's wind.' They climb toward Tower Six
shots.light: clear sun through the scaffold, flickering across them
shots.sound: footsteps on new bamboo — a different, brighter sound than old wood

shots.action: The red water-tank. KIRA scratched into the paint, years old, half rusted over
shots.light: clear sun
shots.sound: wind; kids

shots.action: She puts the KITE SPOOL in his hands and steps back: 'Hold the anchor. Let the corner argue.'
shots.light: clear sun, wind in everything
shots.sound: the two soft sternum-taps from Sc.13 return in the score, alone

shots.action: He looks at the spool. Something in his face MOVES — not memory; the SHAPE of memory. A man recognising the fit of a thing his hands know. '...Huh.'
shots.light: clear sun, warm
shots.sound: wind; line beginning to run

shots.action: He lets the line out. The saffron kite goes up over the Stiltway, over ninety boats, over a rebuilt walkway, into a sky with NOTHING IN IT AT ALL. Kira watching him, not the kite. HOLD. HOLD
shots.light: clear blue, hard sun, the whole frame open
shots.sound: wind, line, city; the full theme, resolving

shots.action: CUT TO BLACK. Title card: THE LAST GUARDIAN. Three seconds later, smaller, fading in: 'the first of the next.'
shots.light: white on black
shots.sound: one held note, then silence

shots.action: POST-CREDITS: the Ark's ballast void, dark, water sloshing, an untaken rope. Sera Vance against a bulkhead, staring at her own reflection in her own broken plate, four months of crying on her face. She whispers her brother's name: 'Tomas.' Again. Getting it right
shots.light: one shaft of white from the hole above; deep black everywhere else
shots.sound: water; her voice; cut to black
